info.title: Pantry API
info.description:
The HTTP API of the `pantry` app, built with TypedPress and served under `/__tp/api/v1` on its WordPress site.

Each request is dispatched to the WordPress REST route behind it, which enforces the app's access rules, field rules, validation and hooks; this API gives the requests and answers one plain shape.

A successful answer is JSON with the result under `data`; a list also has `cursor`, the next page's cursor or null. An error is an RFC 9457 problem document, `application/problem+json`, with `type`, `title`, `status`, `code` and `detail`, and `pointer` when one field is at fault.

Requests sign in as WordPress core accepts: the logged-in cookie with an `X-WP-Nonce` header, an application password, or a TypedPress Identity access token. Each operation says who may call it. A field the caller may not read is left out of rows, and can't be filtered or sorted on.

`typedpress build` writes this document from the app's schema, with the typed client in `tp/_generated/client/` and the app's WordPress Abilities; a component here has the name of the client's type for the same value.

get.description:
The locations rows the caller may read, one page at a time. `limit` is 50 unless given, and at most 100; `cursor` is null on the last page.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: A filter, as JSON: a value or operators per field, with `AND`, `OR` and `NOT`. A filter on a field the caller may not read is refused.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Fields to sort by, comma-separated; `-` before a field sorts it descending (`-createdAt,title`). Fields: `id`, `name`, `kind`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words to find, each at the start of a word, in the title, the content and every text field the caller may read. Only rows the caller may read are found, in the list's own order.

parameters.name: with
parameters.description: What to load with each row, comma-separated or as a JSON object: `items`. A relation holds only rows the caller may read.

post.description:
Creates one locations row and returns it.

Access: Users with the `editor` role or a higher one may do this.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of 1 to 64 characters. A repeat of the request with the same key and body answers with the first result instead of running again; the same key with another body is refused.

requestBody.description: The new row's fields.

get.description:
The user making the request, with their role; null when nobody is signed in.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

Where TypedPress Identity signs users in (null without it), and whether guests are allowed.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

post.description:
Creates a guest user and signs them in. A 404 when TypedPress Identity is not installed or guests are off.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

delete.description:
Ends the TypedPress Identity session the request's access token belongs to. A cookie or application password signs out through WordPress instead, and is refused here.

Access: Any signed-in user may do this.

post.description:
Takes up to 20 reads, each with the `token` of the answer the caller last got, and answers each one as the caller, with every access rule and field rule applied. The typed client's `subscribe` calls it. An answer never says that something changed which the caller may not read.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

requestBody.description: The subscribed reads.

kind.description: The kind, by the name the typed client uses.

args.description: The arguments of that call on the kind: `where`, `orderBy`, `limit`, `offset` or `cursor`, `with`, `search`, `locale`.

id.description: The row of a `get`; or give `args.where`.

token.description: What the previous answer to the same read returned. Opaque.

200.description: One result per read, in order, and the wait the client keeps between two requests.

items.description: `{ changed: true, token, data }` with the read's result as the caller reads it; `{ changed: false, token }` when what the caller holds is current; `{ error }` with the read's problem; `{ pending: true }` when the request ran out of time (ask again).

get.description:
Runs the kinds' `search` on every kind with a searchable field, as the caller. A kind the caller may not read is left out, and so is a `kinds` name that is not a searchable kind.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per kind: 10 unless given, and never more than 50.

200.description: The matching rows, by kind; a kind with none is absent.

get.description:
The app's kinds with the WordPress route behind each, their fields and access rules, its globals and its actions. `typedpress sync` and `typedpress doctor` read it.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

runtime.description: The TypedPress runtime series and the WordPress, PHP, database and plugin versions under it.

kinds.description: Each kind by name: the WordPress route behind it, its fields, relations and access rules.

get.description:
The app's API as an OpenAPI 3.1 document: what `typedpress build` wrote to `tp/_generated/openapi.json`, with this site's address as its server.

Access: Anyone may do this, signed in or not.

title.description: The problem in a few words.

code.description: A stable name for the problem, such as `unauthenticated`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `invalid_input`, `invalid_query`, `invalid_json`, `method_not_allowed`, `unique_violation`, `reference_violation`, `stale_revision` or `locked`.

detail.description: What went wrong, for a person.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the field of the request at fault, when there is one.

fields.description: The fields that differ, as you may read them; null when there is no revision to compare with.

staged.description: Whether someone else changed the staged version (a staged version's token only).

items.description: Present when the request asks for it with `with`.
A filter on the related rows.

shoppingList.description: Present when the request asks for it with `with`.
A filter on the related rows.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: How many rows to return: 50 unless given, and never more than 100.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The `cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one. It replaces `offset`.

Problem.description: An error, as an RFC 9457 problem document.

cookie.name: wordpress_logged_in_{hash}
cookie.description: WordPress's logged-in cookie, as a browser holds it after signing in. A request with it must also carry `X-WP-Nonce`.

nonce.name: X-WP-Nonce
nonce.description: A WordPress REST nonce (`wp_create_nonce('wp_rest')`) for the cookie's session.

applicationPassword.description: A WordPress user name and one of the user's application passwords.
